item.title: Wet weather shakes up Taupō as Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Trophy heads into Round 2 - VelocityNews
item.description: Rain-soaked conditions greeted drivers at Taupō for the first collective test ahead of Round 2 of the 2026 Castrol Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Trophy, with Louis Sharp and Yevan David topping the wet sessions.

item.title: Teenage star Alec Insley storms to perfect start at New Zealand Midget Car Championship at Baypark - VelocityNews
item.description: Teenage sensation Alec Insley has made a flawless start to the 83rd New Zealand Midget Car Championship at Baypark Speedway, winning all three qualifying heats to lead the points after night one.

item.title: Ryan Wood converts Taupo pole into dominant debut single seater win - VelocityNews
item.description: Ryan Wood delivered a flawless weekend at Taupo, converting pole position into his first-ever single seater victory at Round 2 of the 2026 Castrol Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Trophy.

item.title: Proud Kiwi day in Historic GP showcase at Taupo - VelocityNews
item.description: A packed opening day at the Taupo Historic GP saw Ryan Wood claim his first open-wheel victory, thrilling historic battles, and iconic Kiwi race cars return to the spotlight at Taupo.

item.title: Wharton’s first win opens NZ account for TJ Speed with HMD - VelocityNews
item.description: Australian rising star James Wharton claimed his first win in the 2026 Castrol Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Trophy with a commanding Race 2 victory at Taupo Motorsport Park, leading home Ernesto Rivera and series leader Ugo Ugochukwu.

item.title: Hodgson charges to Baypark glory in NZ Midget Championship thriller - VelocityNews
item.description: A fired-up Aaron Hodgson sliced past the top qualifiers in a fast-paced 25-lap final to win the 2026 New Zealand Midget Car Championship at Baypark Speedway on Saturday night. Hodgson raced the final with some extra motivation from frustration with a relegation decision handed down by race officials during the early heats on Saturday night. […]

item.title: Rain master Taylor stuns star-studded field with pole - VelocityNews
item.description: Jack Taylor mastered treacherous wet conditions to claim pole position for the Denny Hulme Memorial Trophy feature race at Taupo in Round 2 of the 2026 Castrol Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Trophy.

item.title: Scoular runs away with race three at Taupo - VelocityNews
item.description: Kiwi star Zack Scoular claimed a dominant 8.4-second victory at Taupo in the 2026 Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Trophy after a bold tyre strategy gamble.

item.title: Wood adds name to iconic Denny Hulme Memorial Trophy - VelocityNews
item.description: Ryan Wood delivered a faultless drive at Taupō to win the Denny Hulme Memorial Trophy in the 2026 Toyota Formula Regional Oceania Championship, adding his name to one of New Zealand motorsport’s most prestigious honours.

item.title: Mustang, Camaro Supercars head south for Teretonga laps - VelocityNews
item.description: Supercars return to Teretonga for the first time in 25 years with live demonstrations, passenger rides and a stacked Repco NextGen NZ Championship event.
